per_article_summaries: Colton Herta will make his F1 weekend debut at the Barcelona-Catalunya Grand Prix on 12-14 June. The 26-year-old ended a seven-season stint in IndyCar to move to Europe and become Cadillac’s test driver for the American outfit’s debut F1 season.

Bernd Maylander has praised Max Verstappen for his foray into GT racing. Maylander is a former winner of the Nurburgring 24 Hours. The four-time F1 champion said he is eagerly watching Verstappen's arc.

Ferrari F1 driver Charles Leclerc was spotted in a custom Fiat 500. The model has a matte black finish, prominent red and white stripes of the Monaco flag and his race number, 16, on the side. The new arrival sits in contrast to the rest of Leclerc's jaw-dropping garage, which features a Ferrari 488 Pista Spider.

Max Verstappen says he fully backs race engineer Gianpiero Lambiase's future move to McLaren. Lambiase is expected to make the move by the start of 2028 at the latest. Verstappen's current Red Bull deal expires at the end of 2028.

Margot Robbie and Bradley Cooper will star in the Ocean's prequel. The heist movie will be set around the 1962 Monaco Grand Prix. The film is yet to be titled, but it is expected to be released in June 2027.

Alpine finished last in constructors’ championship last season but has jumped to fifth in the current standings, ahead of Red Bull. Racing Bulls’ performance, meanwhile, has been mixed; in qualifying it was fifth-fastest in Melbourne, eighth-fastest at Shanghai and seventh-fastest at Suzuka. Racing Bulls is bringing major upgrades to the upcoming events in Miami and Montreal, with the latter upgrade scheduled to replace the former.

Max Verstappen is weighing up his future after being left frustrated by the new-for-2026 regulations, which he claimed are “anti-racing” Red Bull team has suffered a poor start as it is sixth after three rounds. Russell understands why the Dutchman is contemplating walking away, particularly as he’s a very keen GT3 racer.

Martin Brundle has labelled Williams' start to the 2026 season as "very concerning" The Grove outfit has fallen short of expectations after missing private testing in Barcelona at the end of January. Brundle believes the team will have to give up something to get some advantages down the road.

Former Formula 1 driver Karun Chandhok says Jonathan Wheatley is not the answer to Aston Martin's problems. Chandhok believes Wheatley is not the right person to solve the Silverstone outfit's technical issues. Wheatley has not officially confirmed what his next move will be.

Charles Leclerc says Ferrari has made good progress with the car. The Monegasque driver is currently third in the drivers' standings. Ferrari has seen a jump in performance from 2025 to 2026 after the change in regulations. The Maranello outfit finished fourth in the constructors' standings last year.

Former Ferrari team principal Jean Todt reveals Ayrton Senna had been interested in joining the Maranello outfit in 1995. Todt explained that the Brazilian driver was a primary target during the early stages of Ferrari's ambitious rebuilding phase in the 1990s.

Former Formula 1 driver David Coulthard believes it was a "natural development" for Mark Webber to take a step back from his trackside role as Oscar Piastri's manager. The Australian driver announced a change-up in his personal team ahead of the 2026 season.

Formula 1 has a hard limit of 24 races and the series continues to grow its metrics. F1's popularity has led to a surge of interest from prospective host cities, countries and governments. But politicians prematurely declaring a grand prix being a done deal are unlikely to impress the series.

Marco Apicella had barely put the odometer at 800 metres before his time in F1 came to an anti-climactic end. The Italian had earned a late call-up to the Jordan team in 1993 to partner Rubens Barrichello for the Italian Grand Prix. Apicella enjoyed a stronger 1988 season driving for First Racing and finished second at Monza.

Kimi Antonelli has won two races in his first season in Formula 1. The young Italian is currently second in the championship. F1 CEO Stefano Domenicali says Antonelli is an inspiration for young drivers. Domenicali says it will be interesting to see how Italian fans respond to Antonelli.
